webintoappChecklist: Set app URL to your hosted myChat HTTPS origin (preferred) or local HTTPS for testing
Enable Microphone / Audio permission in WebInto.app Permissions
Allow your API host in network / cleartext rules only if you must use HTTP (HTTPS recommended)
Self-signed LAN certs often fail inside WebView — use a real TLS cert or trusted local CA for packaged apps
Voice notes need a user tap (already implemented) so the runtime permission prompt can show
notes: js/native-bridge.js calls WebInto.app permissions CHECK/ASK for AUDIO before getUserMedia when Native.call exists
Drawing and whiteboard need no extra Android permissions
Pictionary is feature-flagged off in the UI by default
